::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 18th 1861  
**From:** Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell/Cobweb-2
:::

Most submissive [Cobweb](people/person_675.qmd),

The only change that I would suggest this time would be that for the word Evangelists you should substitute Gospels – as the Forms to which you refer rather symbolize the characteristics of the Gospels themselves than of their writers The [answers](organizations/other_104.qmd) will carry you all very deep and high.

[The Humble Bee](people/person_81.qmd)[^1] will be delighted with [Kepler](people/person_1850.qmd) as the stars are her peculiar line. We shall have such beautiful stories of [Handel](people/person_1851.qmd) that I much look forward to him, but I wonder if any one will take the new view of [Wallace](people/person_1852.qmd)?

your faithful

Mother Goose

---

[^1]: Tiny 95mm x 54mm blue envelope addressed to ‘Miss Helmore/6 Cheyne Walk/Chelsea/SW’ postmarked Winchester 18 March 1861 and London 19 March 1861,
[^2]: (Frances) Emily Moberly (1844-1921) was a Gosling as Humble Bee from 1859-1868(?),
